name: Federated Vehicle Re-Identification Benchmark
description: A benchmark for evaluating vehicle re-identification performance under federated learning settings with proposed evaluation protocols and aggregation strategies.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) and rank-k accuracy (e.g., rank-1 / rank-5)
reputation: Niche benchmark for federated vehicle re-identification research with limited but growing use in privacy-aware reID studies.
notes: Challenges from non-IID client data, privacy constraints, and aggregation strategy choices; results can be sensitive to simulation setup (client splits, communication rounds); non-LLM vision benchmark.
